screening.reason: Meets inclusion 2/3: derives 30 resting-state-network biomarkers from ABIDE I+II (group-difference analysis, ASD vs TD) and validates them against a local cohort with group-difference and ROC/AUC analyses.

evidence_spans.text:
This study included 1112 ABIDE I datasets 
from 17 sites and 983 ABIDE II datasets from 16 sites. The ABIDE datasets were obtained online15. In total, 2095 
ABIDE datasets were used (ASD: 1001 and TD: 1094; 5–64 years).
evidence_spans.claim: Biomarkers were derived from the full ABIDE I+II release: 2095 subjects (1001 ASD, 1094 TD) across 33 sites.

evidence_spans.text: We recruited 21 patients with ASD and 23 individuals with neurotypical development (TD).
evidence_spans.claim: Biomarkers were validated on an independent local cohort of 21 ASD and 23 TD participants.

evidence_spans.text:
We subsequently applied 
dual-regression analysis18 by using the FSL general linear model (GLM) and the 10-brain resting-state networks 
(RSN10), “PNAS_Smith09_rsn10.nii.gz,” provided by Smith et. al.19,20 as a reference.
evidence_spans.claim: A lab-made FSL pipeline with ICA dual-regression against the Smith09 RSN10 template was used (no ROI atlas).

evidence_spans.text:
(1) FC val-
ues significantly different [family-wise error (FWE)-corrected p < 0.05] between the ASD and TD groups and (2) 
voxels inside the corresponding R-masks to create A1–A20 masks (ASD > TD: A1 to A10 and ASD < TD: A11 to 
A20).
evidence_spans.claim: Biomarker masks (A1-A20) were derived from FWE-corrected two-sample t-test group differences between ASD and TD in ABIDE, with explicit direction (A1-A10: ASD>TD; A11-A20: ASD<TD).

evidence_spans.text:
The results indicated that the biomarkers 
generated from the default mode and executive control networks significantly differed between the 
participants with ASD and TD. In particular, the biomarkers derived from the default mode network 
were negatively correlated with the raw scores and model factors of the SRS.
evidence_spans.claim: DMN- and executive-control-network-derived biomarkers differed between ASD and TD and correlated negatively with SRS severity scores.

evidence_spans.text:
The results of this study indicate that the FC of DMN in the ASD group was 
weaker than that of the TD group.
evidence_spans.claim: DMN functional connectivity was weaker (hypoconnectivity) in ASD than TD.

evidence_spans.text:
The areas 
under the curve (AUCs) for the biomarkers were (0.590, 0.745, p < 0.05), (0.588, 0.646), and (0.646, 0.677) for 
(R4, A4), (R5, A15), and (R8, A18), respectively.
evidence_spans.claim: ROC analysis on the local cohort gave AUCs up to 0.745 (A4, DMN-derived biomarker), significantly higher than its R-template counterpart.

evidence_spans.text:
The pipelines, as well as the 30 masks of this study, are available28. The 
open-science materials and tools, including the RSN10 template, C-PAC, ABIDE, and our pipeline, can be used 
to replicate the methods of this study.
evidence_spans.claim: The 30 biomarker masks (not the local participant data) are shared publicly, aiding methodological but not full cohort reproducibility.

evidence_spans.text:
Data Availability
The datasets generated during and/or analyzed during the current study are available from the corresponding 
author on reasonable request.
evidence_spans.claim: Underlying datasets (including the local KMUH cohort) are available only on reasonable request, not as an open participant list.

assessments.support:
ABIDE I+II full release composition (2095, 17+16 sites) is given, and the local KMUH cohort has explicit inclusion criteria (age 12-22, IQ>70, DSM-IV-TR/ADOS diagnosis): "Both groups of participants 
were between 12 and 22 years old and had scores of >70 in either the full-scale Wechsler Adult Intelligence 
Scale or full-scale Wechsler Intelligence Scale for Children, Fourth Edition."
Local cohort recruitment (active follow-up psychiatric clinic and community at KMUH) and ABIDE source are both described.
FSL-based pipeline (FSL-BET, FSL-BBreg, FSL-FNIRT, CompCor, dual regression against RSN10) is described step by step.
Local ASD diagnosis is explicitly based on DSM-IV-TR criteria and the Autism Diagnostic Observation Schedule; ABIDE diagnoses are the contributing sites' own clinical diagnoses.
24 motion parameters and CompCor components are regressed at the individual level, but no age/sex/site covariate adjustment is reported for the pooled ABIDE I+II group-difference analysis.
No site-harmonisation or covariate-adjustment step is described when pooling ABIDE I (17 sites) and ABIDE II (16 sites) for the two-sample t-test used to derive the A-masks.
Dual-regression functional connectivity against the validated Smith09 RSN10 template is a standard, well-described outcome measure.
FWE-corrected two-sample t-tests (FSL-randomise, 5000 permutations) for group differences, and FDR-adjusted p-values for the SRS/SNAP correlation analysis.

risk_of_bias.summary: Cohort, pipeline and diagnosis sources are clearly described, and statistical correction is appropriate, but no age/sex/site covariate handling is reported when pooling ABIDE I and ABIDE II across 33 sites to derive the biomarker masks.

charting.feature_extraction_tools: Lab-made pipeline based on FSL (FSL-BET, FSL-BBreg, FSL-FNIRT, CompCor, dual regression), noted as methodologically similar to C-PAC
charting.specific_features: Dual-regression functional connectivity against the Smith et al. 2009 RSN10 resting-state network template (no discrete ROI atlas)
charting.specific_algorithms: Two-sample t-test (FWE-corrected) for group differences; receiver operating characteristic (ROC) analysis of individual biomarkers
charting.validation_methodology: Biomarkers derived from the full ABIDE I+II dataset, then independently validated (group difference, correlation, and ROC/AUC) on a separate local (KMUH) cohort
charting.performance_metrics: AUC (ROC analysis), Pearson correlation coefficients, FDR-adjusted p-values
charting.key_performance_results: DMN-derived biomarker A4 AUC = 0.745 (significantly higher than the RSN-template-only biomarker R4, AUC = 0.590, p<0.05) for distinguishing ASD in the local cohort
charting.features_associated_disorder: Default mode network (DMN) and executive control network (ECN) biomarkers differed significantly between ASD and TD
charting.feature_change_direction: DMN functional connectivity was weaker (hypoconnectivity) in ASD than TD; A4 (DMN) biomarker negatively correlated with SRS severity scores
charting.dataset_openly_available: The 30 biomarker masks and pipeline are shared on GitHub (https://github.com/htygithub/ASDmask/); the underlying datasets (including the local cohort) are available only from the corresponding author on reasonable request

items.support: N by diagnosis given for both ABIDE I+II and the local cohort, with explicit local inclusion criteria.
Motion parameters regressed but no subject-exclusion motion threshold given.
ICA/RSN10 template used instead of a discrete ROI atlas.
Local diagnosis explicitly based on DSM-IV-TR criteria and ADOS; ABIDE diagnoses are the contributing sites' own clinical diagnoses.
Independent local validation cohort avoids direct leakage, but no leakage-control statement for the ABIDE-internal derivation.
ABIDE I and II pooled across 33 sites with no site covariate or harmonisation.
Biomarker masks/pipeline public; underlying data only on reasonable request.

narrative_row.study_design_sample_dataset: Both (biomarker group-difference derivation + ROC/AUC validation); ABIDE I+II (2095 subjects, 1001 ASD/1094 TD, 33 sites) for derivation, local KMUH cohort (21 ASD, 23 TD) for validation.
narrative_row.methods: FSL-based lab-made pipeline; dual-regression functional connectivity against the Smith09 RSN10 template; FWE-corrected two-sample t-tests to derive 30 biomarker masks (R1-R10, A1-A20); ROC/AUC and FDR-corrected correlation analyses in the local cohort against SRS/SNAP-IV scores.
narrative_row.outcomes: DMN and executive-control-network biomarkers differed significantly between ASD and TD; DMN connectivity was weaker in ASD; DMN-derived biomarker A4 reached AUC 0.745 in the local cohort, significantly outperforming its RSN-template-only counterpart (AUC 0.590); DMN biomarkers correlated negatively with SRS severity.
narrative_row.key_limitations: No age/sex/site covariate handling when pooling ABIDE I and II across 33 sites for the derivation step; no motion-exclusion threshold reported; underlying datasets available only on reasonable request (biomarker masks/pipeline are public).
narrative_row.relevance_notes: A clear example of deriving a biomarker from the full ABIDE I+II release and testing its transfer to an independent, non-ABIDE clinical cohort, including an explicit ROC/AUC diagnostic-utility evaluation.
